metadata.description: A curated collection of Agent Skills for AI video creation — prompting, generation, editing, subtitles and programmatic motion graphics

plugins.name: video-prompt-studio
plugins.description: Turn an idea into a structured, model-ready JSON video prompt with reference-image guidance

plugins.name: openrouter-video-gen
plugins.description: Generate short AI video clips via OpenRouter, cost-first and one clip at a time

plugins.name: seedance-video
plugins.description: Plan, prompt and render multi-shot Seedance videos with staged approval

plugins.name: text-to-video
plugins.description: Conversational text-to-video generation with a draft, edit and export workflow

plugins.name: motion-graphics-video
plugins.description: Direct and render a motion-graphics MP4 from HTML/CSS/SVG with Chromium and ffmpeg

plugins.name: remotion-video
plugins.description: Build a product or brand video in React and Remotion, from brief to rendered MP4

plugins.name: remotion-best-practices
plugins.description: Domain-rule router for Remotion: animation, captions, audio, charts, 3D and more

plugins.name: ai-video-production
plugins.description: End-to-end narrated explainer and music-video production for a solo creator

plugins.name: ffmpeg-video-edit
plugins.description: Local FFmpeg video editing with a machine-readable tool contract and verification

plugins.name: video-subtitle
plugins.description: Extract, transcribe, translate, burn and visually edit video subtitles

plugins.name: ai-video-editor
plugins.description: Natural-language ffmpeg and yt-dlp editing: trim, merge, silence, shorts and YouTube clips

plugins.name: ai-avatar
plugins.description: Create a consented digital twin or photo avatar that speaks in a cloned voice with lip sync

plugins.name: lipsync
plugins.description: Drive a face's mouth from an audio track, or dub a line onto existing footage

plugins.name: video-localization
plugins.description: Ship one approved video master in many languages: dubbing, captions and translated image text

plugins.name: watch-video
plugins.description: Let an agent watch a video via timestamped frames and transcript to answer questions about it

plugins.name: video-understanding
plugins.description: Build a scene-level understanding index of a video: scenes, transcript, observations and a brief

plugins.name: thumbnail-video
plugins.description: Generate distinct YouTube thumbnail variants from video frames with rendered caption text
